Good Things Network

Web app

  • UX
  • UI
  • CSS
  • Magnolia
  • Angular

Good Things Foundation has a network of around 5000 community organisations who provide support to digital-excluded people - refugees, immigrants, older people and a surprisingly large amount of young people. The revamped National Digital Inclusion Network site now provides resources, events, news & management of member online accounts.

The challenge

We had a very short timescale to replace an underused (and regularly complained about) old system with a new one which was easier to use. The leadership of the technology team changed quite often and we had a new CTO coming in corporate tech background.

I had so many roles on this project.
